queries:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT record_count,
         1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
compared AS (
  SELECT record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS mean_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - mean_share) AS avg_excess
FROM compared
WHERE share > mean_share

WITH status_counts AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.healtheval), ''), 'Missing') AS health_safety_status,
        COUNT(*) AS conservation_records
    FROM scanconservation AS c
    JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.healtheval), ''), 'Missing')
),
group_shares AS (
    SELECT
        health_safety_status,
        conservation_records,
        100.0 * conservation_records
            / SUM(conservation_records) OVER () AS share_pct
    FROM status_counts
)
SELECT health_safety_status, conservation_records, share_pct
FROM group_shares

WITH site_counts AS (
    SELECT s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
           COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS site_count
    FROM sites AS s
    JOIN scanconservation AS c ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_shares AS (
    SELECT site_count,
           1.0 * site_count / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM site_counts
),
compared AS (
    SELECT site_count,
           share,
           share - AVG(share) OVER () AS excess
    FROM status_shares
)
SELECT AVG(site_count) AS avg_site_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM compared
WHERE excess > 0

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval AS health_safety_status,
         COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanconservation AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT health_safety_status,
         record_count,
         1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS status_share
  FROM status_counts
),
weighted_mean AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count * status_share) / SUM(record_count) AS mean_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count,
       AVG(status_share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(status_share - mean_share) AS avg_excess
FROM status_shares
CROSS JOIN weighted_mean
WHERE status_share > mean_share

WITH status_counts AS (
    SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM scanconservation AS c
    JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
    GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
status_shares AS (
    SELECT record_count,
           100.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS percentage_share
    FROM status_counts
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT record_count,
           percentage_share,
           percentage_share - AVG(percentage_share) OVER () AS percentage_point_excess
    FROM status_shares
)
SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(percentage_share) AS average_percentage_share,
       AVG(percentage_point_excess) AS average_percentage_point_excess
FROM qualified
WHERE percentage_point_excess > 0
